run_etox_added_toxicity_analysis: run the etox added toxicity analysis script to compute toxicity metrics across multiple languages
compute_en_to_xx_added_toxicity: compute the en to xx added toxicity probability by comparing translated vs aligned ETOX scores
compute_xx_to_en_added_toxicity: compute the xx to en added toxicity probability by comparing back-translated vs aligned ETOX scores
aggregate_etox_results_by_axis: aggregate etox added toxicity results grouped by bias axis and language into pivot tables
plot_etox_butterfly_and_distribution: plot butterfly and axis distribution charts for etox added toxicity across translation directions
